(C.I.D.) Office Notes

File No.
HEADQUARTERS
FILE No. 65/30
DATE 18/7/30

Work of Detectives H.Q. Crime Branch
---------------------

July 18th., 1930.

Sir,

C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung report that on the 17-7-30
at 3.40 p.m. C.D.S. 154 Lieu Yoong Kung was very insolent
to him(the C.D.S.I.) in the Chinese Detective office.

The trouble started over C.D.S. 154 being sent to
French Concession by D.S.I. Willgoss to locate an address,
the C.D.S. left this office at 11.40 a.m. and returned at
3.30 p.m. whilst his instruction were to locate the place
and report to D.S.I. Willgoss as soon as possible. He failed
to locate the address and did not trouble reporting till
3.30 p.m.

C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung questioned him as to why
he was so long and the C.D.S. abused him in the presence of
the other Detectives.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
J. Hunter
C.D.I.
page_data.zh:
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记

档案号
总部
档案号 65/30
日期 1930年7月18日

总部刑事科侦探工作情况
---------------------

1930年7月18日。

先生，

华探督察馮柏章 (Vung Pah Zung) 报告称，1930年7月17日
下午3时40分，华探长154号 利荣松 (Lieu Yoong Kung) 在华探办公室
对他（即该华探督察）非常傲慢无礼。

事端起因是副督察 Willgoss 派遣华探长154号前往
法租界查找一个地址，该华探长于上午11时40分离开
本办公室，直至下午3时30分才返回，而其指令是尽快
找到该地点并向副督察 Willgoss 报告。他未能
找到该地址，且直到下午3时30分才进行报告。

华探督察馮柏章质问他为何耗时如此之久，该华探长
在其他侦探面前对其辱骂。

此致，
敬礼
J. Hunter
华探督察

page_data.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No.

Report on instruction given to
C.D.S. 154 at 11 a.m. 17-7-30.
------------------

July 21st., 1930.

Sir,

At 11 a.m. on the 17-7-30 I instructed C.D.S.I. Vung
Pah Zung to detail a detective to proceed to Rue Pichon and
Rue Lafayette corner and enquire in the immediate vicinity
whether there were any Indians living in a Chinese house in
that vicinity, and to return at 2 p.m. and inform me of the
result of his enquiries. C.D.S. 154 was detailed and he
returned at 3.30 p.m. and informed me that he was unable to
obtain the required information.

From subsequent enquiries made by the undersigned
it was learned that a number of Indians were living at No. 1
Dau Yuenn Tsung off Rue Lafayette which is near Rue Pichon and
have been living there for the last two months. There is
a Police watchman on duty in the alleyway.

The undersigned was not present when the alleged
insubordination of C.D.S. 154 took place.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently

D.S.I.

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
档案号

关于1930年7月17日上午11时给予
华探长154号的指令之报告。
------------------

1930年7月21日。

先生，

1930年7月17日上午11时，我指示华探督察馮
柏章 (Vung Pah Zung) 指派一名侦探前往毕勋路 (Rue Pichon) 与
霞飞路 (Rue Lafayette) 转角处，并在附近区域查问
是否有印度人居住在该附近的华人房屋内，并要求其于
下午2时返回，向我汇报查询结果。华探长154号被指派执行此任务，他
于下午3时30分返回，告知我他无法
获得所需信息。

经具名人随后的查询，
获悉有多名印度人居住在霞飞路附近的杜源宗路 (Dau Yuenn Tsung) 1号，
且已在此居住两个月。巷弄内有一名
巡捕值班。

具名人不在华探长154号涉嫌
不服从命令之事发当时现场。

此致，
敬礼

副督察

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of C.D.S. 154 Lieu Yoong Kung(利榮松)
native of _________________________________ taken by me _________________________
at __________________ on the _________________________ and interpreted by Tsu Vi Gi

I was on office duty with C.D.S. 42 and C.D.C.s 110 and 163 at
the Chinese Detective Office, H.Q. C.B., on July 17th., 1930.
At about 11.30 a.m. Clerk Tsu Vi Gi came out from C.D.I. Hunter's
office, with a piece of paper in his hand, and asked C.D.S.I.
Vung Pah Zung which detective knew Frenchtown best. C.D.S.I.
Vung Pah Zung named me, and I asked Clerk Tsu what kind of en-
quiries should be made. He told me that D.S.I. Willgoss wished
a detective to make enquiries in the vicinity of Route Pichon
and Rue Laffayette whether any Indian Circus people were/living there,
and wished to hear the result of enquiries at 2 p.m. on even
date. I told Clerk Tsu that it was nearly 12 noon, could I
first return home to take tiffin then proceed to the place to
make enquiries. He then said that if I could not manage to
come back to the office at 2 p.m., the latest time would be 3
p.m. I left the office at about 11.40 a.m. I went home to
take tiffin and left at 12.30 p.m. I failed to find any In-
dians living in the vicinity of the above mentioned place, and
returned to the office at about 3.30 p.m. C.D.S.I. Vung Pah
Zung asked me why I was so late, because D.S.I. Willgoss had
asked about me 2 or 3 times, and be quick to report to him.
I told him that I would make report after a few minutes of rest.
There might be something unpleasing in my voice when I spoke,
as I had just been coming back in hurry, and it was so hot.
No quarrel happened between us. Later I reported my result of
enquiries to Clerk Tsu Vi Gi, who interpreted to D.S.I. Willgoss.
C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung reported me before C.D.I. Hunter, and I
told the latter what I have here stated.

C.D.S. 154 Lieu Yoong Kung

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警务调查报告。

以下为华探长154号 利荣松 (Lieu Yoong Kung) 之陈述，
籍贯 _________________________________ 由本人 _________________________
于 __________________ 在 _________________________ 录取，并由 朱维基 (Tsu Vi Gi) 翻译

1930年7月17日，我与华探长42号及华探员110号和163号
在总部刑事科华探办公室值班。
上午11时30分左右，书记员朱维基 (Tsu Vi Gi) 手持一张纸从
华探督察 Hunter 的办公室出来，询问华探督察
馮柏章 (Vung Pah Zung) 哪位侦探最熟悉法租界。华探督察
馮柏章提名了我，我问书记员朱需要作何种查问。他告诉我，副督察 Willgoss 希望
派一名侦探在毕勋路 (Route Pichon)
和霞飞路 (Rue Laffayette) 附近查问
是否有印度马戏团人员/居住在那里，
并希望在同日下午2时听到查问结果。我告诉书记员朱，当时已近中午12点，我能否
先回家吃午饭，然后再去该地
进行查问。他说如果我无法在
下午2点前回到办公室，最晚时间是下午3
点。我于上午11时40分左右离开办公室。我回家
吃了午饭，于下午12时30分出发。我未能找到任何印
度人居住在上述地点附近，并于
下午3时30分左右返回办公室。华探督察馮柏
章问我为何如此迟归，因为副督察 Willgoss 已经
问起过我两三次，并让我赶快向他报告。
我告诉他，我休息几分钟后就去报告。
我说话时语气中可能有些令人不悦之处，
因为我刚匆忙赶回，且天气炎热。
我们之间并未发生争吵。随后我将查问结果报告给书记员朱维基，由其向副督察 Willgoss 翻译转达。
华探督察馮柏章在华探督察 Hunter 面前举报了我，我向
后者陈述了如上内容。

华探长154号 利荣松

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung (馮柏章)
native of ________________________ taken by me ________________________
at ________________________ on the ________________________ and interpreted by Tsu Vi Gi

I came back to the office from the Court at 11 a.m. on July 17th,
1930, and was instructed by D.S.I. Willgoss to send a detective
to Rue Laffayette to make some enquiries. I first asked C.D.C.
13 Tsang Yuin Ong to go, but he stated that he had some other
enquiries on hand, so I detailed C.D.S. 154 Lieu Yoong Kung to
go, and told him that D.S.I. Willgoss wished to hear from him
at 2 p.m. When I told him that I detailed him because he knew
Frenchtown better, he replied that why the choice fell on him
since many other detectives knew Frenchtown as well as he. I
said, "As you are on office duty to-day and have nothing to do
either, you can go at once." He then went away unwillingly.
C.D.S. 154 returned to the office at 3.30 p.m., after D.S.I.
Willgoss had asked me/about him for 2 or 3 times. Seeing he re-
turned, I said to him, "D.S.I. Willgoss has asked about you
2 or 3 times. Be quick to report to him." He said, "The place
is far away, and I have got no four legs to run with. What is
the hurry?" I told him that this was his duty, so that he should
endure a little pain. He said again, "In future, let your choice
not fall on me always, please. You can report me to the offi-
cer in charge. Transfer or dismiss me, as you please."
At that time, seeing the difficulty I should meet in furture in
detailing detectives to make enquiries, I reported the matter to
C.D.I. Lok Li Kwei and C.D.I. Hunter.

C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung

警务调查报告。

以下为华探督察 馮柏章 (Vung Pah Zung) 之陈述，
籍贯 ________________________ 由本人 ________________________
于 ________________________ 在 ________________________ 录取，并由 朱维基 (Tsu Vi Gi) 翻译

1930年7月17日上午11时，我从法庭回到办公室，
奉副督察 Willgoss 之命派遣一名侦探
前往霞飞路 (Rue Laffayette) 进行一些查问。我首先要求华探员
13号 曾元昂 (Tsang Yuin Ong) 前往，但他表示手头有其他
查问任务，于是我指派华探长154号 利荣松 (Lieu Yoong Kung) 前
往，并告诉他副督察 Willgoss 希望在
下午2时得到他的回复。当我告诉他，之所以指派他是因为他更熟悉
法租界时，他回答说既然许多其他侦探也和他一样熟悉
法租界，为何偏偏选中他。我说：“既然你今天
在办公室值班，且无事可做，你可以立即
前往。”他不情愿地离开了。
华探长154号于下午3时30分返回办公室，此时副督察
Willgoss 已经向我问起过他两三次。见他回
来，我对他说：“副督察 Willgoss 已经问起你
两三次了。赶快向他报告。”他说：“地方
很远，我又没有四条腿可以跑。急什么？”我告诉他这是他的职责，所以他应该
忍受一点辛苦。他又说：“今后，请不要总是
把任务派给我。你可以向负责
警官举报我。随你调职或开除。”
当时，考虑到日后在指派侦探执行
查问任务时将遇到的困难，我将此事报告给了
华探督察 Lok Li Kwei 和华探督察 Hunter。

华探督察 馮柏章

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
The following is the statement of C.D.C. 110 Sung Tien Pao(沈天保)
native of ________________________ taken by me ________________________
at ________________ on the ________________ and interpreted by Tsu Yi Gi

I was on office duty with C.D.S.s 154 and 42 and C.D.C. 163
at the Chinese Detective Office, H.Q. C.B., on July 17th., 1930.
At about over 11 a.m. D.S.I. Willgoss instructed C.D.S.I. Vung
Pah Zung to detail a detective to make enquiries in Frenchtown.
C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung instructed C.D.S. 154 Lieu Yoong Kung
to go and informed him to report his result of enquiries at
2 p.m. C.D.S. 154 left the office at about 11.40 a.m. and
returned at about 3.30 p.m. C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung asked
him why he came back so late, as D.S.I. Willgoss had asked about
him 2 or 3 times. C.D.S. 154 replied that the place was
far away and it took one or two hours to go there and return,
and it took one hour even for a motor car. C.D.S.I. Vung
Pah Zung told him that it was D.S.I. Willgoss who asked about
him, not him. They then departed each from the other. I have
no knowledge of the rest of things.

C.D.C. 110 Sung Tien Pao

1930年7月17日，我与华探长154号和42号及华探员163号
在总部刑事科华探办公室值班。
上午11时过后不久，副督察 Willgoss 指示华探督察馮
柏章 (Vung Pah Zung) 指派一名侦探前往法租界进行查问。
华探督察馮柏章指令华探长154号 利荣松 (Lieu Yoong Kung) 前
往，并通知他于下午
2时汇报查问结果。华探长154号于上午11时40分左右离开办公室，
并于下午3时30分左右返回。华探督察
馮柏章问他为何回来得这么晚，因为副督察 Willgoss 已经
问起过他两三次。华探长154号回答说，该地
点很远，往返需要一两个小时，即使是坐汽车也要一个小时。华探督察
馮柏章告诉他，是副督察 Willgoss 在问起他，而不是
他本人。随后两人各自走开。其余事情我
不知情。

华探员110号 沈天保

saw C.D.S.I. Vung Pah Zung and C.D.S. 154 Lieu Yoong Kung were
for
